title: The Frank Tapes
description: Just Ronnie and Frank, one on one, after midnight. It starts calm. It does not stay calm. Generated with Dia.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's just you and me tonight, Frank. Barry went home. Said he needed to be around normal people.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: (laughs) Normal people. That's good, Ronnie. That's real good. Normal people are exactly who they recruit.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: See, this is why I keep you on the line. Nice and easy. Walk me through it.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Okay. So. You know how you wake up tired, even after a full night's sleep?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Sure. I just figured that was the coffee. Or my age.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: It's not the coffee, Ronnie. Sleep is when they update you. That's when the changes go in.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Update me. Huh. Like a phone.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Exactly like a phone. A real rest would leave you sharp. They don't want you sharp, Ronnie. Think about it.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I mean... I have been a little foggy lately. But that's normal, right? That's just life.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Is it? Or is that what they updated you to think? When did you last feel truly awake?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I... huh. I actually can't remember. That's a strange thing to not be able to remember.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Now you're listening. Now you're awake, Ronnie. And here's the part nobody wants to hear.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay. Okay, hit me. I'm ready.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: The escalators. They're not taking you up, Ronnie. They're counting you. Every single step.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Wait. Wait, I ride one of those every day. At the mall. Every single day, Frank.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: And where do the steps GO when they fold under at the bottom? Where do they GO, Ronnie?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I don't... I always assumed they just loop around underneath, I never actually...

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Nobody looks! That's the whole point! They go DOWN, Ronnie. All the way down, to the warehouse!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The warehouse?! The same one from the pigeon...

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: ALL one warehouse! It always was! The pigeons, the bread, the escalators, ONE ROOF!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Oh, I don't feel good. I don't feel good, Frank, I rode it twice today, TWICE!

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: Then they counted you twice! (gasps) You're in deep, Ronnie. You are in DEEP.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: What do I do?! Frank, what do I DO, tell me how to get...

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: You take the stairs! The regular ones! The ones that DON'T MOVE! Promise me, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I promise! I promise, no more escalators, never again! (sighs) Okay. Okay. Deep breaths.

lines.speaker: caller-frank
lines.text: (sighs) Good. You're gonna be okay. Stay awake, and take the stairs. That's all any of us can do.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We're gonna take a quick break. I need to sit down. Don't trust the escalators, folks. Stay awake out there.
